messages:
liam: Heads-up — canary 2212 for model-x shows p99 token latency +18% and p50 +6 after merge 7f3a2. CI perf-staging job failed (staging-perf-24).

deploy-bot: Canary deploy paused automatically by rollout-guard (latency-slo breach).

jess: ugh. any immediate suspects? that PR touched kernel-selection and the adaptive batching probe at the same time.

liam: both look suspicious. top-down flame shows kernel_select_topk cost up ~30%. additionally KV miss rate jumped from ~4% -> ~12% for the canary. kv-prefetch heuristics changed in the PR.

anya: flame link: http://perf/reports/2212/fg.html — focus on kernel_select_topk and kv_fetch_path. small annotated snippet in the report.

karim: quick config check — the merge enabled kernel_autoselect=true and adaptive_batch_probe_v2=true. we can force kernel=avx512-opt to check impact.

gabi: can we bisect? my brain: git bisect start HEAD good v7.2.3; git bisect run ./ci/perf_run.sh --suite=latency --model=model-x — but full bisect is slow.

liam: did a targeted bisect on staging images: isolated culprit to commit 7f3a2 — the kv-prefetch TTL/eviction heuristic tweak. reverting that locally returns p99 to baseline.

jess: nice. do we revert in canary immediately or patch runtime to be more conservative?

karim: suggest patch: revert kv-prefetch heuristic for now + reduce adaptive probe aggressiveness. also add a synthetic CI case that injects kv-miss spike to avoid regressions slipping through.

anya: also propose changing the rollout guard: require a synthetic canary probe that includes kv-miss>=10% for 30s and verify p99 < 200ms before advancing. current guard only looks at p50/p90 which misses miss-spike tail.

liam: sounds good. I'll open a cherry-pick PR to revert the kv change and include the perf test reproducer and graphs. will also add the canary probe script.

deploy-bot: Release blocker ticket created: RB-783 — canary paused.

gabi: another note — kernel_autoselect still causing churn. add metric kernel_switch_rate; if > 0.1 switches/min then hold rollout and force a stable kernel.

jess: ack. assign liam + karim to the revert + perf test. anya to own rollout-guard update and docs.

liam: timeline: PR in ~30m. after merge we re-run canary and manually unpause; if p99 still >10% over baseline we will auto-revert to previous image.

karim: I'll enable more aggressive profiling during the next canary (perf map + AFDO sampling) so we can see hot paths.

anya: +1. I'll update canary gating docs and add the kv-miss probe example.

sre-bot: Incident note created: INC-2212. No pager triggered.

liam: thanks all. PR checklist in description: reproducible steps, before/after perf graphs, kv hit-rate trace, kernel_switch_rate metric, rollback criteria. will post updates here once CI runs.

jess: thx — ping when PR is up and when canary restarts.
